exposure: Infants born to mothers with COVID-19
outcome: Clinical findings in infants (fever, runny nose)
cohort: 60 newborns admitted to a Newborn Intensive Care Unit between March 2020 and April 2021, including those born to mothers with COVID-19 and those with community-acquired COVID-19.
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had higher rates of maternal mortality, preterm birth, and cesarean section, while infants born to mothers with COVID-19 did not have increased mortality; the study also found a high rate of formula feeding in both groups.
gest_age: 36.8+/-3.3 weeks (infants born to mothers with COVID-19)
birth_weight: Low birth weight was an outcome
